name: japanese-speaking-coach
description: Voice-first Japanese speaking rehearsal with coaching in the learner's chosen first language.

interface.shortDescription: Rehearse spoken Japanese with coaching in your language.
interface.longDescription: Practice real Japanese interactions, explanations, and spoken summaries through attempt, focused repair, replay, and variation. Choose any coaching language while keeping the speaking task in Japanese.
defaultPrompt: Rehearse a Japanese phone call and coach me in Traditional Chinese.
Help me explain an idea in Japanese and coach me in Spanish.
Recommend a Japanese speaking task and use my language for feedback.
